items.stem: What is the next term in the sequence 3, 7, 11, 15, …?
Explain how to tell whether a sequence is linear or quadratic from its differences.
items.answer: A linear sequence has constant first differences; a quadratic sequence has constant second differences.
items.markingKey: B1 linear: constant first differences; B1 quadratic: constant second differences [2]

items.stem: Explain why the coefficient of n² in the nth term of a quadratic sequence is half the second difference.
items.answer: For an² + bn + c the first differences are a(2n + 1) + b, which change by 2a each time; so the second difference is 2a.
items.markingKey: B1 second difference = 2a; B1 so a = half [2]

items.stem: The first five terms of a sequence are 12, 17, 22, 27, 32. (a) Find the nth term. (b) Find the 100th term.
